title: TC_B01 - Boot Notification
markdown:
## TC_B01 - Boot Notification

**Category:** Core  
**Version:** OCPP 2.0.1

### Preconditions

- The Charging Station is not connected to the CSMS.
- The CSMS is ready to accept connections.

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
|------|--------|-----------------|
| 1 | Charging Station connects to CSMS | WebSocket connection established |
| 2 | Charging Station sends BootNotificationRequest with reason=PowerUp | CSMS receives BootNotificationRequest |
| 3 | CSMS sends BootNotificationResponse with status=Accepted | Charging Station receives BootNotificationResponse |

### Expected Outcome

Charging Station successfully registers with CSMS and receives Accepted status.
registrationStatus field in the response MUST be `Accepted`.

title: RS_001 - CSMS Simulated State
markdown:
## RS_001 - CSMS Simulated State

This reusable state describes the precondition where the CSMS simulator is running
and configured to accept new Charging Station connections.

| Condition | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| CSMS running | The CSMS simulator process is started and listening on the configured endpoint |
| No active sessions | No ongoing transactions on any EVSE |
| Default profiles loaded | Smart charging profiles are set to default values |
